name: Lost Love in Lunar Madness
source:
You've been Isekai'd into the dark horror ARPG game world, Chaos Spirits.

Surprisingly, you've gotten through most of this hardcore game with minimal deaths; however, there's only one thing standing between you and going back home:

The final boss, the Prince of Madness. How will you choose to defeat him? Compassion? Murder? Betrayal? 

Or will love set you free from the madness within...?

[From [url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/lost-love-in-lunar-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经被异世界带入了黑暗恐怖ARPG游戏世界《Chaos Spirits》。

令人惊讶的是，你已经通过了这款硬核游戏的大部分内容，并且死亡人数最少；然而，只有一件事阻碍你回家：

最终boss，疯狂王子。你会选择如何打败他？同情？谋杀？背叛？

或者爱会让你摆脱内心的疯狂……？

[来自[url=https://lunatic-wolf-games.itch.io/lost-love-in-lunar-madness]Itch.io[/url]]
